messages.content: What's the average temperature for Los Angeles in December?

message.content:
In December, Los Angeles enjoys mild, Mediterranean‑style weather. Typical averages are:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Average high | ~68 °F (≈20 °C) |
| Average low | ~48 °F (≈9 °C) |
| Daily mean (average of high & low) | ~57 °F (≈14 °C) |

So you can expect daytime temperatures in the upper 60s °F (low 20 °C) and nighttime lows in the mid‑40s °F (around 9 °C). The city rarely sees temperatures below freezing in December.
